notes.text: Apps can now declare a role, connector or plugin, and an MCP server in app.json (contract 5), and apps made for contract 4 keep working

notes.title: Assistants
notes.text: An assistant such as Claude can read your site but can’t change anything. Open Settings, then Assistants, copy the address into your assistant, sign in with GitHub and tap Allow. Disconnect removes it.

notes.title: Connectors
notes.text: You no longer copy an id by hand. A connector signs in to its service, such as Calendly, and fills a setting from the service’s own list. Open Appstore under Settings and choose Connectors; each page shows where it connects.
For app builders: the build now refuses a plugin that lists a host in csp or uses fetch, WebSocket or import of a URL

notes.title: Appstore sections
notes.text: Themes, connectors and plugins are easy to tell apart. Open Appstore under Settings and pick Themes, Connectors or Plugins at the top. A connector names its service, and a plugin has no outside access.
